summary: Frontend-only validation of Cockpit corrections (Vision default carousel, NightRecap list+badge 70/30, mobile order, dark/light theme, onboarding text). All acceptance criteria are met on both desktop 1440px and mobile 390x844 for Thomas account.

issues: A 'Cockpit — mode d'emploi' onboarding modal overlays the cockpit on first load. It is dismissible and does not affect functional testing (data-testid checks pass under it), but the main agent may want to gate it behind a first-visit flag to keep the cockpit visible immediately.

critical_code_review_comments: InspirationScreen/Onboarding replay flow is fine textually; the 'mode d'emploi' modal appearing on Cockpit could persist across sessions if not stored in localStorage — verify a data-testid='cockpit-guide-close' click writes a flag so it doesn't overlay the cockpit on every load.
NightRecap correctly derives tasks from data.activite_recente; when Thomas' activity is non-empty (2 items observed) the list renders — matches spec (no fake data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 requested Cockpit checks pass. data-testids verified: vision-default-carousel, vision-personalize-btn, cockpit-night-recap, night-recap-ratio, night-task-*, ambiance-toggle-btn, ck-greeting/ck-vision/ck-priorities/ck-kpis/ck-night/ck-sequence/ck-insights/ck-quote. Mobile grid order = greeting/vision/priorities/kpis/night/sequence/insights/quote as expected (App.css lines 154-170). No horizontal scroll. Old 'Valeur générée' 3-stat block removed. Onboarding final screen texts 'déjà rempli', 'pré-rempli', 'Score d'alignement calculé' are absent from source (Onboarding.jsx now says 'ton cockpit est prêt' + 'Vision Board à personnaliser').
